title: and those with him
name: Arethas
troparia: (Tone 1) Opposing the vile king and reproaching his disbelief in Christ,* this martyr acted bravely and suffered torture and death.* For this the angels praise you, O Arethas, and those who suffered with you,* and generations of the faithful will always bless you* as a sure intercessor for our souls.
kontakia: (Tone 4) Today is the truly splendid feast of the martyrs,* an intercession of happiness is ours today.* Let us celebrate this feast* and bless the Lord in heaven.
